basis: Illustrative replacement links: retain up to ten September and eight December A319/A320 exits when their mapped MAX replacement batch is delayed. Assume maintenance and crew support, one month notice, at most nine months extension and eighteen simultaneous retained aircraft. Additional maintenance $0.02M and rent/other carrying $0.01M per aircraft-month; 90% productivity and 15% extra fuel burn. These are analyst assumptions, not United clearance, costs or a fitted policy.
